artworks.title: Portrait of a Shopkeeper
artworks.creditLine: The Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two men captured from head to toe, standing in front of a backdrop. The man on the left is standing side-on, facing the other man, and he is holding an umbrella and a slender object in his hands. He is wearing a dark overcoat and a wide-brimmed hat. His facial features include a visible profile with short hair. The man on the right is standing behind a counter or table, facing forward. He is wearing a three-piece suit with a vest, and his facial features include short hair and a mustache. There are no visible earrings or necklaces on either man. Around them, there is a large basket on the floor beside them, and behind the counter, there are jars and a box with illustrations. The background features a painted scene resembling an outdoor garden setting with a large decorative urn and plant, giving an impression of a studio setting with props and backdrops used to mimic an outdoor market or garden environment.

artworks.title: Wicker Chairs
artworks.creditLine: The Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two wicker rocking chairs. The larger chair on the left side has a more elaborate woven backrest design compared to the smaller chair on the right. The color palette of the image is predominantly sepia-toned, giving it a vintage appearance. The chairs are placed on a patterned floor, with a neutral backdrop emphasizing their intricate, woven construction.

artworks.title: Wicker Chair
artworks.creditLine: The Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a wicker rocking chair with a high, curved back and intricate woven patterns. The color palette consists of sepia tones, with shades of brown and beige. The rocking chair is positioned slightly to the right of center on a patterned floor, against a simple, lightly textured wall backdrop, framed within an aged-looking border.

artworks.title: Wicker Chair
artworks.creditLine: The Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a wicker rocking chair with a high backrest, placed slightly off-center. The color scheme is sepia-toned, creating a vintage atmosphere. The chair is on a checkered-patterned floor, with a plain wall in the background showing some texture and speckles.

artworks.title: Coverlet and Carpet Weaving Factory Interior
artworks.creditLine: The Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a textile factory interior. The image shows a room filled with wooden machinery and equipment used for weaving, including a large loom in the center. Spools of thread and rolls of textiles are visible at different stages of production. Natural light is present in the room, casting shadows across the workspace. The photo captures the industrial aesthetic and working environment of an early factory setting, with wooden beams and frameworks contributing to the architectural structure of the activity area.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Cooper
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, facing forward with his hands resting on his lap holding a hammer-like object. He is wearing a long-sleeve shirt with an apron and trousers. A wooden chair supports him, with a large barrel beside him. The background is an intricately designed studio backdrop with ornate patterns, columns, and a vase. The photograph exhibits signs of age like scratches and worn edges.

artworks.title: The Artist in the Attic
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E.M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure from the side, sitting on a chair in a pose with their chin resting on their fist. The person is wearing a long coat and has short, curly hair. There are artist's tools around them, including an easel or drawing board and a bag with brushes. The setting is an attic or studio with wooden beams in the ceiling.

artworks.title: Iris ochroleuca
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roger and Barbara Ditman
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of an iris plant with detailed white flowers and yellow accents. Green leaves accompany the flowers. In the center, the main iris plant is depicted with flowers. Adjacent to it, there are sketches of a petal and the structure of the iris flower.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist upward seated in a portrait style, facing slightly to the right. She has dark hair and is wearing a dark dress with lace collar and cuffs, accessorized with a brooch, lace detailing on the sleeves, and bracelets. The background is a dark hue, typical of daguerreotype portraits, and the photograph is framed with a gold-colored border.

artworks.title: Phosphate Mining in South Carolina
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a construction area with workers digging and handling materials. In the background, there are trees indicating a wooded area. Some figures are standing or moving near tracks, with a horse-drawn cart transporting goods. The image is in sepia tones, giving it an antique quality.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Native American Man
artworks.creditLine: Chief Curator Discretionary Fund
artworks.description: This image depicts a man seated, with his body slightly angled to the right. The man has distinct facial features, long hair styled with plaits and wearing traditional attire. He is adorned with necklaces and holds an object in his hand. The background is plain, and the portrait is framed with intricate floral designs.

artworks.title: Flora Stewart
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: An elderly woman is seated in a chair, captured from the waist up. She is sitting upright, facing forward with her hands resting in her lap. She has a calm expression. Her facial features include deep-set eyes and a serene demeanor, with her hair covered by a dark headscarf. She is wearing a dark, richly textured dress adorned with a broad, white lace collar. The sleeves and front of her dress feature ruffles. She holds a cane in her right hand, resting its handle on her knee. The background consists of a simple wall. The chair is partially visible with a wooden texture and elegant detailing on one side.

artworks.title: Title Page for the series "Picturesque Views of American Scenery"
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with watercolor additions on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jo Ann and Julian Ganz. Jr.
artworks.description: This image depicts a scene by a body of water with lush trees, a stone slab with inscriptions, and more foliage in the background. The horizon is unclear and the sky is lightly tinted above the tree line. The color palette consists of muted greens, browns, blues, and grays, creating a serene natural setting.

artworks.title: View of the Spot Where General Ross Fell, Near Baltimore
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with watercolor additions on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jo Ann and Julian Ganz. Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a pathway cutting through a dense forest. Tall trees dominate the scene, forming a canopy with lush foliage. A horse with a rider is traveling along the path in the lower part of the image. Sunlight filters through the trees, creating dappled shadows and a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Oyster Cove
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with watercolor additions on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jo Ann and Julian Ganz. Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a cove with water, cattle grazing, a forest, a clear sky with billowing clouds, and tall trees with moss. The lighting is warm with soft shadows. Colors include greens, browns, blues, and grays with a realistic texture.

artworks.title: Spirit Creek; Near Augusta, Georgia
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with watercolor additions on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jo Ann and Julian Ganz. Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a view of Spirit Creek near Augusta, Georgia. The perspective is slightly elevated and captures the features of the landscape. A line of tall trees and dark clouds obscure the high horizon. The rocky, sloped ground near us has a path leading into greenery. A small creek winds through the scene, lined with trees and rocks. Some trees are highlighted with detailed foliage, contrasting with surrounding darker trees. The color palette includes dark greens, browns, and occasional light green touches in the foliage, with a grayish sky.

artworks.title: L.C. Todd
artworks.creditLine: Robert Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, facing the camera. Her features include smooth, dark hair, pointed chin, soft lips, and a straight nose. She wears a patterned dress with a high neckline and lace-trimmed sleeves. She holds an open case with a framed photo or daguerreotype. The background is plain, and the image is bordered by a gold frame in a red velvet case.

artworks.title: A Fakeer at the Door of a Mosque, Constantinople
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, gum arabic, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of an architectural interior and exterior scene featuring people engaged in various activities. The scene is set in a covered outdoor area with stone columns and archways leading to an open courtyard. Inside the covered area, there is a richly decorated interior space with ornate tilework on the walls. Carpets and cushions are placed on raised platforms. The courtyard beyond is bathed in natural light, with shadows casting intricate patterns. Trees provide a canopy of greenery.

artworks.title: Au Jardin d'Acclimatation (In the Zoological Garden)
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two women from a side view. One woman is leaning slightly forward with her arms on a low fence, and the other woman stands behind her. The woman in front has a delicate facial profile and her hair is styled under a decorative hat. She appears to be holding something small in her hands. She is wearing a high-collared dress with intricate patterns. The second woman is wearing a hat as well, and her facial features are less distinct due to the angle. The setting is outdoors with foliage in the background, and birds are present, with several on the ground nearby.

artworks.title: Au Jardin d'Acclimatation (In the Zoological Garden)
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two women in a partial side profile extending from the waist up. They are standing close together with one directly behind the other, both facing towards the right side of the frame, engaged in observing birds. The woman in the foreground has detailed facial features with a straight nose and distinct lips, and her hair is styled high, possibly with a hat or a lace headpiece on top. She is wearing a garment with voluminous, ruffled sleeves and elaborate detailing. The woman slightly behind her has similar styled features, wearing a headdress that drapes down her shoulders. The surrounding environment is depicted as a natural setting, with varied bird species on the ground, and trees in the background, suggesting a peaceful outdoor scene. The sketch is rendered in delicate pencil lines, giving a sense of texture and depth to the clothing and the background foliage.

artworks.title: Au Jardin d'Acclimatation (In the Zoological Garden)
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman leaning over a fence observing birds in a dense foliage and tree background. The artistic technique involves detailed etching lines accentuating the woman's attire and the birds. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and gray. The setting captures a tranquil moment in a natural environment with a focus on the woman and the birds.

artworks.title: Au Jardin d'Acclimatation (In the Zoological Garden)
artworks.medium: etching with gray and black wash on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: Two women are leaning over a wooden fence observing a group of birds. The woman in the foreground has detailed facial features and dark hair styled under a feather-adorned hat. She wears a dark long-sleeve dress with a high collar. Behind her, a woman with lighter features and a lighter hat observes as well. The background is filled with trees and foliage, creating a rich, textured setting resembling a garden or park. In front of the women, several birds with distinctive plumage can be seen perched or walking on the grass.

artworks.title: Au Jardin d'Acclimatation (In the Zoological Garden)
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting two women behind a mesh fence. One woman is leaning forward against the fence, while the other woman stands slightly behind her. Both have their heads turned to the side. The woman in the foreground wears a hat with flowers and has styled hair in an updo, along with detailed clothing. The other woman also wears a hat and period attire. Birds are in the fenced area, and the background shows detailed foliage and trees, creating an outdoor setting. The etching is on a cream-colored mat with the title "Le Jardin d’Acclimatation" and the artist's name "Bracquemond" inscribed in the corners.

artworks.title: Au Jardin d'Acclimatation (In the Zoological Garden)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: Two women are depicted from the waist up. They are positioned side by side, with one woman in the foreground leaning slightly forward, resting her arms on a lattice fence. Her facial features are lightly sketched, and she has her hair styled neatly back, adorned with a decorative hat featuring feathers or flowers. Her companion stands slightly behind her, casually leaning on the fence, with her face turned slightly to the viewer, gazing into the distance. This woman’s features are also finely depicted, and her hair is styled similarly, with a hat featuring a large plume. Both women are wearing dark-toned garments with full sleeves. There are several birds, like pheasants, on the grassy ground inside the fence. The background features dense foliage and trees.
